goal: Warn operators before background chainstate compaction when free disk space is low
Log compaction start and completion by default to help diagnose unexpected disk exhaustion
agreement: Suggested skipping compaction entirely rather than only logging a warning (andrewtoth)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because background compaction can silently fill the disk and cause node hangs on tight storage
Provides visibility and early warnings to operators without altering compaction behavior
